// purpose: Minimal ACL for a personal automaton deployment.
// model: deny-by-default; only tagged owners hit tagged automaton hosts on serve ports.
// install: Paste into the Tailscale admin UI under Access controls.

acls.//: Owners can reach the engine UI on whichever ports you serve on.
Allow the engine host to reach the same ports on itself (loopback over Tailscale isn't a thing, but worker -> ui via the tailnet IP is).

// ssh (optional): Drop this section if you don't want Tailscale SSH.
// tagging hosts: After applying this ACL, tag your devices:
tailscale up --advertise-tags=tag:automaton           # on the automaton host
Or assign in the admin UI under Machines.
